scenes.setting: The matchbox blaze in the washroom springs the defenders: guards rush the fire, the two watchers hold the diary hall per orders, and Max sprints back confident the block-model artifact will cage any intruder
scenes.text_anchor: “Once you enter, you will be like prey that has fallen into a trap!”

scenes.setting: The spirit-ghost descends into the study and palms both bookmarks — then baby wails, frozen air, eyeballs of squirming worms, and a soft voice from atop the bookshelves: 'Why did you only take the bookmarks?' Klein smiles wide — and vanishes
scenes.text_anchor: “Why did you only take the bookmarks? Where did you learn to only take the bookmarks?”

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog, the escape hatch that needs no escape: ending the self-summoning yanked spirit, whistle and bookmarks clean out of the world — while Max stares at a model that never gained a red dot
Back in his body and Master-Keying homeward through the terraces — until a wall opens onto a blood stench: a woman gutted on the living-room floor, organs gone, and grunting close by
scenes.text_anchor: The strong smell of blood! Klein frowned.
